title: Titanium Air Sparger Pipe
alloyReason: Grade 2 Commercially Pure Titanium provides excellent corrosion resistance in chemical environments, good formability and weldability, and moderate strength. commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)

faq.q: What is a titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: A titanium air sparger pipe is a precision-machined tank hardware component used in perforated air agitation sparger pipe. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium air sparger pipe manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Air Sparger Pipe is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium air sparger pipe?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
